name: topology-diagram
purpose: The deployment topology of a resource as a left-to-right diagram: each column is a depth (domains, project, policy, service, cache rules, integration, storage), each node a collapsible card with the resource kind, its status tag, its name and, when opened, a message and labelled fields; dashed connectors join every node of a column to the next. A node without a name is an unbound slot (dashed, Not bound) and a `bindable` node carries the bind control (bind an existing resource, change it, create one, remove it). Taken from the design sample's workload topology (`TopologyDiagramNodeData`, `TopologyNodeCard`, `TopologyBindNode`, `TopologyBindControl`, the empty node). It reuses `FlowDiagram`'s connector engine and anchors and draws its own list semantics, with no node-graph dependency.
useWhen: The topology tab of a project, service or workload: what serves its traffic, in order, and what is still unbound.
A review before a deploy where binding or removing a resource is staged on the diagram.
avoidWhen: A sequence of steps or a pipeline without data cards → use `flow-diagram`.
A nested list of items with no flow between them → use `tree`.
related: `flow-diagram` — the connector engine and anchors this component reuses.
`detail/resource-detail` — the page whose topology tab holds it.
bestPractices: Keep a column per depth and put the nodes that serve in parallel in the same column.
Mark a staged change `dashed` with a warning status and a message that says the deploy applies it.
Mark the last node of each branch `terminal` so no connector leaves it.
Give every unbound slot a message that says what happens without it.
Give a node `href` when its resource has a page: the name becomes a link that ends in the open glyph (`ai ai-external-link`), as every resource name in the console does.

A node that collects many resources and adds to itself, such as Domains (add a domain), puts its `+` in the `actions` slot: an `IconButton` (`ai ai-plus`, `variant="outline"`, `size="small"`) named `Add domain` inside a `Tooltip`, picked by `node.id`. `bindable` is for a slot that holds one resource (Firewall, Custom Page): it brings its own `+` with the bind menu. Do not hand-draw a node card to get the `+`.

props.name: levels
props.doc: Columns of the diagram, from the entry point to the last dependency.

props.name: loading
props.doc: Shows placeholder cards while the topology loads.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the diagram. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Deployment topology`).

events.name: bind
events.payload: (event: MouseEvent | KeyboardEvent, binding: { id: string; value: string })
events.notes: An existing option was picked in the bind control; `id` is the node's id.

events.name: remove
events.notes: Remove was activated on a bound, removable node.

events.name: create
events.notes: Create was picked in the bind control.

slots.name: actions
slots.notes: Extra controls in a node's identity row, before the bind control.

slots.name: empty
slots.notes: Replaces the default empty state (the package `EmptyState`, small, `topologyDiagram.emptyTitle`) shown when there are no levels.
